decision_conditions:
-	Block plan/ Site survey plan (at a scale of 1:100 showing any site boundaries and existing and proposed features e.g. roads, parking areas, footpaths, landscaping, walls, fences, trees, buildings and other structures)
-	Existing and proposed floor plans (at a scale of 1:50 or 1:100) 
-	Existing and proposed elevations (at a scale of 1:50 or 1:100)
-	Existing and proposed site sections and finished floor and site levels (at a scale of 1:50 or 1:100)
-	Plans to a scale of not less than 1:20 to show all new doors, windows, shop fronts
-	All plans and drawings to indicate; key dimensions (in metric) e.g. width, height and length, and to a recognised metric scale. A scale bar must be included on all drawings.
-         Please could you also clarify the address ?if it is ground floor only, then you will need to update the application form. 

-         We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? 
        'External alterations to the existing shopfront including the replacement and reorientation of the entrance door with a new aluminium framed glazed door, finished in white'.
description: External alterations to the existing shopfront including the replacement and reorientation of the entrance door with a new aluminium framed glazed door, finished in white.
